exercises.q: Tom stood in line for three hours.
exercises.why: **простоял** — простоя́ть (perfective): to stand, to stay (for some time); to stand idle; to stand, to remain (of buildings). Wiktionary: про- + стоя́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to lie ahead, to be at hand, to be in the offing
to stand, to stay (for some time)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: состоя́ние — state, status, condition; состоя́ть — to consist (of); предстоя́ть — to lie ahead, to be at hand, to be in the offing; простоя́ть — to stand, to stay (for some time).
